results.title: Distribution is one stackward is tested on
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: os collector partial: os-release: open /etc/os-release: permission denied; planted for the redaction test DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]

fix.hint: Run on Ubuntu 22.04 or later, or Debian 12 or later, or read results from other distributions with care.

results.title: No reboot pending
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: os collector partial: os-release: open /etc/os-release: permission denied; planted for the redaction test DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]

fix.hint: Reboot in a maintenance window, or set an automatic reboot window for unattended upgrades (see UPD-004).

results.title: Running kernel is the newest installed
results.subject: host
results.message: could not list installed kernels in /boot

fix.hint: Reboot to load the patched kernel.

results.title: Clock is synchronized
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the clock collector did not run

fix.hint: Enable systemd-timesyncd (`timedatectl set-ntp true`) or install chrony.

results.title: Disks have free space
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the disk collector did not run

fix.hint: Prune images and build cache (`docker system prune`), cap logs (LOG-001 to LOG-003) and remove what is not needed.

results.title: Only root has uid 0
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the users collector did not run

fix.hint: Remove the account, or give it a normal uid with `usermod -u` after checking what it owns.

results.title: No login account has an empty password
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the users collector did not run

fix.hint: Lock the account with `passwd -l <user>` or set a password.

results.title: Cloud default account is locked down
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the users collector did not run

fix.hint: Lock it: `passwd -l <user>`, set its shell to nologin, move its authorized_keys aside and drop its NOPASSWD line. Keep your own admin account working first.

results.title: sudoers is root owned and NOPASSWD entries are deliberate
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the users collector did not run

fix.hint: Fix ownership and mode (`chown root:root`, `chmod 0440`), validate with `visudo -cf <file>`, and keep NOPASSWD to the PaaS account.

results.title: Docker group has no extra members
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the users collector did not run

fix.hint: Remove users who do not need it: `gpasswd -d <user> docker`.

results.title: Login accounts are used
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the users collector did not run

fix.hint: Lock unused accounts with `passwd -l <user>` or remove them.

results.title: Root recovery path is known
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the users collector did not run

fix.hint: Store the console or rescue procedure and any root password in a password manager.

results.title: A host firewall is active and denies incoming traffic by default
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the firewall collector did not run

fix.hint: Allow SSH first (ufw allow in on tailscale0 to any port 22, or from one source), then: ufw default deny incoming; ufw enable

results.title: UFW filters IPv6 when the host has a global IPv6 address
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the firewall collector did not run

fix.hint: Set IPV6=yes in /etc/default/ufw, then ufw reload

results.title: SSH is not open to anywhere when a private path exists
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the listeners collector did not run

fix.hint: Allow SSH on tailscale0 and from one explicit source, prove a login over the tailnet from a new session, then delete the public SSH rule

results.title: Exposure: every listening socket and who can reach it
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the listeners collector did not run

fix.hint: Bind services to 127.0.0.1 or the tailnet address instead of 0.0.0.0, or filter the port in the host firewall

results.title: No public 80/443 rule on a tunnel or tailnet only host
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the firewall collector did not run

fix.hint: Delete the rule (ufw delete <number>); ingress is the tunnel

results.title: DOCKER-USER chain state
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the firewall collector did not run

fix.hint: No direct fix: filter published ports in DOCKER-USER (ufw-docker does this) or publish them on 127.0.0.1 only.

results.title: ufw-docker is loaded and lets tailnet traffic reach published ports
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the firewall collector did not run

fix.hint: ufw reload; then ufw route allow in on tailscale0 proto tcp to any port <container-port>

results.title: ufw-docker is not paired with Docker's nftables backend
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the firewall collector did not run

fix.hint: Use Docker's iptables backend with ufw-docker, or filter published ports directly in nftables

results.title: Provider firewall (outside view)
results.subject: host
results.message: the provider firewall cannot be seen from inside the host; run `stackward probe` from another machine to see what is reachable

fix.hint: Add a provider network firewall that allows only the ports your ingress needs

results.title: Automatic security updates are enabled
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the updates collector did not run

fix.hint: apt install unattended-upgrades; dpkg-reconfigure -plow unattended-upgrades

results.title: Unattended upgrades ran recently
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the updates collector did not run

fix.hint: Check the timer (`systemctl list-timers apt-daily-upgrade`) and /var/log/unattended-upgrades/.

results.title: Unattended upgrades include the security pocket
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the updates collector did not run

fix.hint: Include `${distro_id}:${distro_codename}-security` (Debian: `origin=Debian,codename=${distro_codename}-security`) in Unattended-Upgrade::Allowed-Origins.

results.title: Reboot policy is a decision
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the updates collector did not run

fix.hint: Decide: set Unattended-Upgrade::Automatic-Reboot and a time, or schedule a manual reboot routine.

results.title: Release is within standard support
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: os collector partial: os-release: open /etc/os-release: permission denied; planted for the redaction test DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]

fix.hint: Upgrade to a supported release (do-release-upgrade on Ubuntu, the Debian release notes upgrade procedure).

results.title: No pending security updates
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the updates collector did not run

fix.hint: apt update && apt upgrade

results.title: IPv4 forwarding is on where Docker runs
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the sysctl collector did not run

fix.hint: Set net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 in a sysctl drop-in and never let a hardening profile own it.

results.title: Reverse path filter is loose where Docker or Tailscale run
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the sysctl collector did not run

fix.hint: Set net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=2 and net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter=2 (loose) in a drop-in.

results.title: Network sysctls match the hardening baseline
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the sysctl collector did not run

fix.hint: Set the values in a /etc/sysctl.d drop-in and make /etc/ufw/sysctl.conf agree.

results.title: Kernel hardening sysctls match the baseline
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the sysctl collector did not run

fix.hint: Set the values in a /etc/sysctl.d drop-in.

results.title: IPv6 router advertisements are not switched off by a profile
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the sysctl collector did not run

fix.hint: Leave net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra at its default where the provider uses router advertisements, or configure the address statically.

results.title: journald has a size cap
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the journal collector did not run

fix.hint: Add a drop-in /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/size.conf with `[Journal]` and `SystemMaxUse=1G`, then restart systemd-journald.

results.title: Proxy access logs are rotated
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the journal collector did not run

fix.hint: Add a logrotate rule (use copytruncate when the proxy cannot reopen its log).

results.title: Journal disk use
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the journal collector did not run

fix.hint: None; informational.

results.title: A metrics agent is present
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the journal collector did not run

fix.hint: Add monitoring with an alert for disk usage and SSH logins.

results.title: The journal survives a reboot
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the journal collector did not run

fix.hint: Create /var/log/journal (or set Storage=persistent in a drop-in) and restart systemd-journald.

results.title: Self hosted platform detected
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the paas collector did not run

fix.hint: Nothing to fix; this records the platform for the other checks.

results.title: Platform proxy is not published on all interfaces behind a tunnel
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the paas collector did not run

fix.hint: Publish the proxy on 127.0.0.1 only (for example 127.0.0.1:443:443) when ingress is a tunnel; never publish the Traefik dashboard or enable api.insecure.

results.title: Platform panel ports are not open to the world
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the paas collector did not run

fix.hint: Reach the panel over the tailnet or behind an access proxy, and publish its ports on 127.0.0.1 or the tailnet address.

results.title: No platform database is published publicly
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the paas collector did not run

fix.hint: Turn off "publicly available" for the database and reach it over the tailnet or an SSH tunnel.

results.title: Docker Swarm ports are restricted to cluster peers
results.subject: host
results.message: not inspected: the paas collector did not run

fix.hint: Allow 2377/tcp, 7946/tcp and udp and 4789/udp only from the other nodes' addresses (or the tailnet), deny them from anywhere else.
